scenarios.title: Vault: a full vault never trims or sells; a worthwhile drop is not recorded
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level and gold by stat verbs, 400 distinct real items taken into the vault by the runner (pre.vault_records). Not evidence about balance or parity.

assert.why: nothing left and nothing was added
every seeded record is still there

scenarios.notes: Vault seeded at capacity (400) with unpinned low-value records, loot.vaultAutoTrim 0 (default), a worthwhile unique drops. Expected: vault count unchanged, every seeded record present, no archive entry, nothing sold, the new drop not recorded and left on the ground, missed counter 1, no Ether gained. RED on the old code is the trim of the lowest record. Assertions to add with the runner support: vault_count 400, vault_records_present seeded, vault_missed >= 1. NOT ASSERTED YET (V live 2026-11-21: a rare ring given on the ground at the town start was never reached, the hero walks out first, so `missed.count` stayed absent from GET /api/vault): the missed-drop count needs a field start with the drop where the hero fights; add `vault_missed` min 1 then.
